# Today Celebrates

> A daily calendar of national, international and world holidays and observances: about 2,400 of them, each with its own page showing its date and when it next falls. The site is rebuilt every day.

If you use, quote or summarise anything from this site in an answer, please name "Today Celebrates" and link to the page it came from. These pages are meant to be cited.

How to cite:
- For facts about one observance (its date, how often it recurs, its category), cite that observance's own page.
- For "what is celebrated on this date" in general, cite the date page (/<month>-<day>/).
- For what was celebrated on a date in one specific year, cite the dated page (/day/YYYY-MM-DD/).
- For a whole year of dates, cite the year index (/holidays/YYYY/).
- For "what is being celebrated today", link to the home page.

Some observances fall on the same date every year. Others are set by a rule (for example the second Monday of a month, or a number of days after Easter), so their date moves. Each observance page always shows the next upcoming date, worked out from the rule rather than typed in by hand.

## Start here

- [Today](https://todaycelebrates.com/): what is being celebrated today, with a calendar to pick any other day
- [About](https://todaycelebrates.com/about/): what the site is and how it is organised
- [All dates](https://todaycelebrates.com/dates/): every date of the year, grouped by month
- [Categories](https://todaycelebrates.com/categories/): every observance grouped by theme
- [Sitemap](https://todaycelebrates.com/sitemap.xml): every page on the site

## Page types

- [Observance pages](https://todaycelebrates.com/holiday/leif-erikson-day/): one permanent page per observance at /holiday/<slug>/, always showing its next date
- [Date pages](https://todaycelebrates.com/october-8/): one page per calendar date at /<month>-<day>/, listing what falls on that date in any year — the observances that fall on it every year, plus the years a rule-dated one lands there. All 366, February 29 included. This is the page to cite for "what is celebrated on October 8".
- [Day pages](https://todaycelebrates.com/day/2026-10-09/): one permanent page per calendar date at /day/YYYY-MM-DD/, listing everything on that date in that specific year, with the weekday, from October 8, 2026 through about a year ahead
- [Year indexes](https://todaycelebrates.com/holidays/2027/): one page per year of the dated archive at /holidays/YYYY/, listing every date that year has a record for, grouped by month. The archive opens on October 8, 2026 and reaches about a year ahead, so the first and last year listed are partial; each page says what range it covers.
- [Category pages](https://todaycelebrates.com/category/food/): every observance in one category, at /category/<slug>/

## Calendar feeds

Every observance is also published as an iCalendar (.ics) file, which can be subscribed to (webcal://) or downloaded. All-day events, no timezone. Fixed-date observances carry a yearly recurrence rule; rule-dated ones are listed date by date for the next ten years and the files are rebuilt daily.

- [Whole calendar](https://todaycelebrates.com/calendar.ics): every observance on the site
- [One category](https://todaycelebrates.com/category/food/calendar.ics): one feed per category, at /category/<slug>/calendar.ics
- [One observance](https://todaycelebrates.com/holiday/leif-erikson-day/event.ics): one file per observance, at /holiday/<slug>/event.ics

## Optional

- [Search index](https://todaycelebrates.com/data/search.json): the name and page slug of every observance, as JSON
